subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and what core/plugin/security contract should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, storage limits, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace an implementation accordingly.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description media-understanding path instead.

options.title: Start provider-specific
options.body: Let provider plugins prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace an implementation accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest visible combination of issue-routing context and adjacent media-understanding/video helper history.
